# CANDIDATE: VWAPCONT_DTE_OVERRIDE_3DTE_4DTE

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** trigger_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The vwap_continuation signal exhibits a persistent edge when traded at longer DTE (3 or 4 days weekly options) due to reduced theta decay, similar to the observed monotonic improvement from 0DTE to 1DTE to 2DTE in the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate. We hypothesize that DTE=3 and DTE=4 will further improve OOS expectancy and Sharpe ratio over the held-out window (last 4 months) while maintaining the signal's directional accuracy.

## Mechanism

We isolate the DTE variable by keeping the vwap_continuation signal trigger identical (same entry logic, same ITM-2 strike selection, same -8%/+30% exit targets) but changing the option DTE to 3 or 4 days (weekly options). The signal fires as usual, but we trade the corresponding weekly option contract instead of 0DTE. All other parameters (stop, TP1, runner, profit-lock) remain unchanged from the base vwap_continuation configuration.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L (based on ITM-2 weekly option premium ~$3.80, 28 contracts = $10,640 risk, 50% of $25K).
2. **Sample bias:** We plan to test over the last 4 months (held-out window) for walk-forward OOS. Sample size is approximately 60-80 trading days. Overfit risk is mitigated by using the same signal logic as the proven 0DTE vwap_continuation and only varying DTE.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window: last 4 months)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days: expected zero trades, so validation is trivial; but we require real-fills check on non-J days to confirm signal fills)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: potential whipsaw in low-volatility regimes; max drawdown: estimated <15% of account if signal fails; blow-up scenario: unexpected gap through stop due to news event (mitigated by -8% stop and 15:50 ET time stop).
6. **Concentration:** We expect the signal to be distributed across days; if top-5 days exceed 50% of P&L, we will disclose. Currently unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest.
